subject: Future Tech
title: Level 4: The Robotaxi Reality
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Level 4: The Robotaxi Reality.

hook.text: In San Francisco, you can hail a Waymo robotaxi with no driver, no steering wheel backup.

buildup.text: Level 4 means full autonomy within a defined area.

discovery.text: Waymo operates over 100,000 paid robotaxi rides per week. Passengers ride in the back. The front seat is empty.

twist.text: Level 4 only works in mapped, tested areas. Take the same car to a new city and it can't drive. Geography is its leash.

climax.text: Expanding Level 4 city by city is the current strategy. Each new city requires months of mapping and local testing.

punchline.text: Fully autonomous, but only where it's already been.

quiz.question: How many paid robotaxi rides does Waymo complete weekly?
